messages:
erin: Heads-up team — before we push the benchmark blog + webinar pages live next week, we need a lightweight URL sanity plan: redirects, canonical rules, JSON-LD event schema, OG cards, sitemap entries, and the HubSpot UTM->property mapping. Can someone own the sweep and assemble a small output (CSV for redirects + small JSON-LD snippet + CRM mapping table)?

sam: I can run the URL crawler and assemble the redirect CSV. Will output `/old-url,to-url,code,reason` lines. Where should I drop it?

erin: Put the raw CSV in the GDoc first: https://docs.google.com/drive/fake-webinar-web. I'll move to infra PR once we agree.

seo-bot: automated crawl finished — found: 5 near-duplicates (same content, different query strings), 2 legacy event pages that should 301->current, 1 paginated index that needs canonical to the clean path, and missing OG:title on the blog hero. Full scan inserted into the GDoc under "crawl-results".

taylor: For JSON-LD, suggest Event schema with VirtualLocation + Offer (free). Sample to adapt:
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference: Inference Benchmarks","startDate":"2026-04-15T16:00:00-07:00","endDate":"2026-04-15T17:00:00-07:00","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.com/webinar/inference-benchmarks"},"offers":{"@type":"Offer","url":"https://redwood.com/webinar/inference-benchmarks/register","price":"0"}}
```

erin: Perfect — include eventStatus and sameAs if we reference a partner page. Also ensure startDate uses ISO offset.

sam: Redirect CSV draft example I'll add: `/events/bench-2023,/webinar/inference-benchmarks,301,consolidate legacy event` and mark `/events/old-overview, ,410,remove obsolete` for 410s.

seo-bot: canonical guidance: set `<link rel=\"canonical\" href=\"https://redwood.com/webinar/inference-benchmarks\" />` on all variants. Do not canonicalize pages with UTM params — canonical should be the clean path. Add `noindex` to `/register/thank-you` and any gated resource list pages.

crm-bot: CRM mapping proposal: utm_source=webinar, utm_medium=email|social, utm_campaign=inference-bench-2026. HubSpot: map `utm_campaign`->contact property `orig_campaign`, set `lead_source=webinar`, and set lifecycle stage to `lead` + add to list `webinar_inference_2026`. Also append `hs_redirect=inference-bench-2026` query param on post-reg redirect for webhook parsing.

erin: Good. We need the redirects to preserve UTMs and append hs_redirect. For infra tests include curl example: `curl -I \"https://redwood.com/events/bench-2023?utm_source=test\"` should return `HTTP/1.1 301` and `Location: https://redwood.com/webinar/inference-benchmarks?utm_source=test&hs_redirect=inference-bench-2026`.

taylor: Internal linking plan: 1) add contextual links from product pages (at least 2 spots) 2) add hub link on blog index hero 3) avoid vague CTAs; anchors should be descriptive like "inference benchmarks" or "benchmarking LLM inference".

sam: Sitemap update: add `/webinar/inference-benchmarks` with priority 0.8 and lastmod today's date. I'll include a small patch to the sitemap XML in the doc.

erin: Owners + due dates: sam = redirect CSV + sitemap patch (Due Wed EOD), taylor = JSON-LD + OG meta copy + internal linking anchors (Due Tue AM), crm-bot (workflow doc from alexa team) = UTM->HubSpot mapping and webhook spec (Due Tue), erin = coordinate PR & QA check.

seo-bot: extra checks: ensure server-side 301s are canonical-preserving, check robots.txt doesn't block the new paths, and confirm sitemap is submitted to Search Console after PR.

erin: I'll open the GDoc and tag each owner. Please paste short test output to the doc once you have the redirect entries. Ping here for any blockers. :raised_hands:
